versions.changelog: New icon. The shared helper keeps its connection file private, clears update records on the last disconnect, and keeps the network route you chose when an update check fails.
Balance and cost questions now answer from a live account read rather than from figures written into the package.

- Initial release of shopify-pdp-set skill.
- Converts seller-supplied product facts into a set of 4 to 8 Shopify product-page stills for a single SKU, with one still per named theme.
- Provides detailed workflow for planning, confirming, generating, reviewing, and delivering Shopify PDP stills.
- All operations are executed through the bundled MCP client, not via direct API or local files.
- Includes clear guidance for handling input requirements, billing confirmation, image inspection, and safe update procedures.
